summary.en: [Updated] More Racial Ability Tuning on WoW: Forever...
summary.es: [Actualizado] Más ajustes de capacidad racial en WoW: para siempre...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has added more racial ability tuning in WoW: Forever, affecting Orcs, Undead, and Skyborne.

Edit #1 (10:00 AM): A change to Troll Berserking has been added.

Yesterday's Tuning Pass
Blizzard
View Original
We’ve updated the previous post in this thread with some additions that were intended to be listed.

Additional updates to Racial Abilities and Talents include:

Orc
  • Blood Fury’s cooldown reduced to 2 minutes (was 3 minutes).
Troll
  • Berserking duration increased to 15 seconds (was 10 seconds).
Undead
  • Touch of the Grave internal cooldown reduced to 15 seconds (was 25 seconds).
We’d also like to clarify that for Skyborne:
  • Charged persists through death, and is removed upon entering a raid.
  • Attuned persists through death, and is removed upon entering a raid.

title.en: EllesmereUI Adds Fellowship-Inspired Nameplate Kick Tracker
title.es: EllesmereUI añade un rastreador de patadas en la placa de identificación inspirado en las becas

summary.en: EllesmereUI Adds Fellowship-Inspired Nameplate Kick Tracker...
summary.es: EllesmereUI añade el rastreador de patadas de la placa de identificación inspirado en la comunidad...

contentHtml:
The popular EllesmereUI has added a new feature: a kick tracker that shows interrupt cooldowns right on the nameplate!

Download EllesmereUIEllesmere UI Kick Tracker


EllesmereUI is a popular addon that can customize many aspects of the World of Warcraft UI. From the cooldown manager to a revamped chat frame, it offers many modules, and players can customize and use as many or as few as they like.

One of EllesmereUI's newest features is a nameplate kick tracker inspired by Fellowship, where players' interrupts are tracked on the side of a nameplate. When a player successfully interrupts a cast, a box is added to the side of that creature's nameplate that shows the interrupting ability and tracks the remaining cooldown. If multiple players kick the same mob, nameplates will show multiple interrupts. This allows you to see the remaining cooldown of all interrupts next to each other. Then, when an interrupt is available, it will automatically slide next to the nameplate, indicating who should kick next!


Source: Ellesmere UI


This module can also show your kick cooldown before the first interrupt by tracking your assigned Focus Kick marker, which is great for organized groups. EllesmereUI includes standard kick tracking as well, for those who prefer a standard interrupt box.

 


It's important to note that interrupt tracking only works off of successful interrupts. This is a major downside but has nothing to do with EllesmereUI. This is just what addons can pick up right now, and unfortunately, it's probably unlikely to change going forward, as Blizzard has commented that they are likely to add more restrictions to Interrupt Trackers.

title.en: Racial Ability Tuning Pass for WoW: Forever
title.es: Pase de ajuste de habilidad racial para WoW: Forever

summary.en: Racial Ability Tuning Pass for WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Racial Ability Tuning Pass para WoW: Para siempre...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has announced upcoming racial ability tuning for the launch of WoW: Forever!
Blizzard
View Original
As we approach the launch of WoW Forever, we’ve been reflecting on feedback we’ve heard on racial abilities and passive traits: Some players have expressed that some of the new racial traits feel too generic, while others have expressed concerns that some are objectively stronger than others.

In taking a final pass on these, we’ve prioritized racial identity, which means that some races will naturally be slightly more effective than others at certain combat roles. In some places where we had replaced role- or class-focused racials with generic ones, we’re rolling those changes back. One exception to this is the weapon specialization racials, like humans’ Sword Specialization or orcs’ Axe Specialization. While those have a strong fantasy component to them, it is not healthy in the long run for future raid and dungeon loot tables to be evaluated through the lens of “required” weapon types.

At the same time, we’re doing a tuning pass on some of the remaining passive bonuses to help ensure that they aren’t skewing outcomes in a way that limits player preferences.

Racial Abilities and Traits

  • Human
    • Ruthless now increases critical chance by 1% (was 2%).
    • Human Spirit now increases Spirit by 10% (was 5%).
  • Dwarf
    • Earth Fury (2% increased critical strike damage and healing) removed.
    • Added: Artisan’s Precision - Increases hit chance with spells and attacks by 1%.
  • Tauren
    • Plainsrunning now grants 2% movement speed per stack (was 1%), for a total max increase of 60% (was 30%).
    • Plainsrunning no longer increases mounted movement speed.
    • Endurance no longer provides any modifiers beyond 5% increased Health (no hit chance or critical damage modifiers).
  • Orc
    • Savage removed (1% increased critical strike chance).
    • Command re-added, increasing Warlock and Hunter pet damage by 5%.
  • Skyborne
    • Wind-Blessed Haste bonus reduced to 2% (was 3%).
    • Read Leyline now increases Mana and Health regeneration by 50% (was 100%), with a 15-second duration. This ability cannot be used while Innervate is active, and will be replaced by Innervate as a more powerful effect.
    • Using Read Leyline at a Ley Line now also grants “Attuned” for 1 hour. While Attuned, the benefit of Read Leyline is increased to 100% regeneration increase. Attuned persists through death.
    • Skysight is now a 15% increased movement speed (was 10%), with a 15-second duration.
    • Using Skysight at an elemental convergence now also grants “Charged” for 1 hour. While Charged, the benefit of Skysight is a 30% movement speed increase. Charged persists through death.
